# Vendored Three.js runtime

This directory contains the classic browser build of **Three.js 0.160.1**.
It is pinned and committed so every game continues to launch directly from a
local `file://` URL without a package install, web server, CDN, or network
connection.

- Runtime: `three.min.js`
- Upstream package: `three@0.160.1`
- Upstream package integrity: `sha512-Bgl2wPJypDOZ1W6hTDseLRhLInXnFC8cODd7qBqS6NNXoI76CrLkcCwTCNOmV3k6Hn6qJNmwTOXWrQTBQ==`
